adversarial_objections: Elementary bookkeeping of one deterministic algorithm from an undergraduate-research paper.
Record wording is defective; exact-scope binding is a root decision.
Error term O(sqrt n log n) is much weaker than the source data suggest.
Bounded search of two strings; a generic proof may exist though none was found.
347063.strongest_positive: A printed conjecture half unaddressed by the published follow-ups, resolved with an exact constant, no reduction to a prior theorem, and a genuine structural step with a delicate endgame.
347063.strongest_negative: A single-algorithm move count by elementary means, with half the conjecture already public and a defective record literal.
